pages.text: A bare charm does nothing on its own - it has to be socketed into an Aura Belt to actually pulse. The belt holds two charms at once, so you always have to choose which two auras you're carrying.

pages.title: Socketing
pages.text: No GUI needed: hold the belt in one hand and a charm in the other, then right-click. It doesn't matter which hand holds which.

pages.title: Removing
pages.text: Sneak and right-click with the belt in hand and your other hand empty to pop the most recently socketed charm back out. A quick right-click with both hands empty just shows you what's currently socketed.
